data: Does the dashed red line reach a higher validation loss than the dashed blue line in the right subplot?

The question asks whether the dashed red line reaches a higher validation loss than the dashed blue line in the right subplot. 

From the caption, we know that the figure shows the effect of overfitting on DNN models through cross-entropy loss for two datasets: AG News and Sentiment 140. The right subplot corresponds to the Sentiment 140 dataset.

In the right subplot, the dashed red line represents the validation loss without augmentation, while the dashed blue line represents the validation loss with SynthMix augmentation. 

By visually inspecting the right subplot, we can see that the dashed red line (without augmentation) generally remains above the dashed blue line (with SynthMix augmentation). This indicates that the dashed red line reaches a higher validation loss than the dashed blue line in the right subplot.
